answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 8870 Country: India Title: Brother, Due to baldness, I am wearing wig (artificial hair) before wearing the wig I do wadoh at morning then wear the wig. In case I need to do wadoh again how I do ? Can I perform masah(wadoh part) upper the wig. Pls advice soon, Thanks! Question: Brother, Due to baldness, I am wearing wig (artificial hair) before wearing the wig I do wadoh at morning then wear the wig. In case I need to do wadoh again how I do ? Can I perform masah(wadoh part) upper the wig. Pls advice soon, Thanks! Answer ID: 8870 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1484/1251=L/1429) The masah shall not be valid if done on the wig; therefore it is necessary to do masah after putting off the wig. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
